recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not make another core source edit for FHIR-31717 unless a future tracker changes the desired Observation Statistics terminology metadata.
issue_request: FHIR-31717 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised against R4B for OO and applied for R5. It reported that the observation-statistics CodeSystem was invalid because it lacked the required status element and other useful metadata that had been present in R4, including contact, content, description, valueSet, and title.
initial_application: The missing status element was restored through the overlapping FHIR-31716 application commit 8ea4fe880ed1d97b8bd407003b2f4ad2f40a8f12. FHIR-31717 was then explicitly applied by aa8d109be14567f37976cba622d645dd7647ca78, which added title, experimental=false, date, publisher, contact, description, and valueSet to source/observation/codesystem-observation-statistics.xml.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the Observation folder CodeSystem source is in current build scope. FHIR-34452 later raised similar concerns for the ValueSet/CodeSystem family but was retracted after the submitter found the R4B pages looked better. FHIR-37449 later adjusted broader terminology metadata and is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current CodeSystem has status=active, experimental=false, publisher, contact, description, valueSet, content=complete, and the current title, so the published correction is already present.
